svg.text: Hilbert and Morton keys on an 8 × 8 grid
Each cell shows its key. The line visits the cells in key order: hilbert_encode / morton_encode([x, y]::UTINYINT[2]).
Consecutive keys are always neighbouring cells.
Interleaved bits: long jumps between quadrants.
x runs left to right and y bottom to top; the dot marks key 0.
